data.name: Silver Bullet Biochar
data.description: Silver Bullet Biochar is a Singapore-based biochar venture with a minimal public footprint — only a bare LinkedIn page (2 employees) and a registered domain. No press coverage, registry listings, partnerships, or evidence of biochar deliveries or carbon credit issuance were found in web research. Pathway is biochar (pyrolysis of biomass).
